title: Eddington's eclipse confirms general relativity

tellings.quote: theory and of all people it would take an enemy of Germany um uh Eddington uh to um do the the work on capturing the deviation of a star around the sun during an eclipse

plain: In 1919 the British astronomer Arthur Eddington measured how starlight bent around the sun during a solar eclipse, the work that backed Einstein's theory of general relativity. A guest named Greg Rogers tells Michels this as history, without naming a source, and dwells on the irony that it took a man from Germany's wartime enemy, Britain, to confirm the German-born Einstein's theory.
